thread:
alex: Heads up — customer flagged missing audit entries for token exchanges in the API gateway between 2026-03-18 21:00-22:00. We have connect/authz events but no 'token_issue' events. Anyone see ingestion gaps?

maria: I noticed the same window. Gateway forwarded payloads but our collector threw a parser error when it saw a new field `grant_type`. Likely caused a drop.

sam: Which services look affected? api-gateway, auth-service, console, billing, runtime?

alex: Primarily api-gateway and auth-service. Console and billing look fine so far. Runtime might be missing KV cache invalidation events tied to refresh flows.

helen: Assigning a quick triage — I'll run a targeted search across s3/ingest for 'token_issue' and 'grant_type' and surface any raw payloads. ETA ~2h.

maria: Found the exception in audit-ingest logs: `KeyError: 'grant_type'` in audit-ingest v1.2.3. Patch idea: make parser tolerant of additional keys and store full payload in `event.raw` so we don't drop unknown shapes.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rolled back audit-ingest v1.2.3 -> v1.2.2 due to 503 spikes on 3 nodes at 21:15 UTC.

sam: That rollback would explain the exact drop window. Action items: we need customer-facing validation and internal monitors that assert event schema presence per service (api-gateway, auth, console, billing, runtime) so this doesn't slip by again.

alex: Proposed backlog: 1) tolerant parser + raw payload storage 2) e2e synthetic audit validation that exercises token flows 3) KMS-integrated signing for sensitive events (token_issue, token_revoke, rbac_change) 4) Document RBAC change event mapping for console/billing and surface to support teams. I'll file the tickets.

helen: :thumbsup: I'll pick up #1 and #2. Maria — can you own #3 (KMS signing)? Sam — can you handle #4 (RBAC mapping)?

maria: Happy to take #3. Quick question on KMS design: do we want per-tenant signing keys or a single region key to start? Per-tenant is safer but adds infra/mgmt work.

sam: Start with region-level keys so we can ship quickly, add per-tenant keys as a later phased enhancement. Document tradeoffs in the RFC.

alex: Also we need a short KB note about the missing events during the rollback window and how customers can request re-hydration or evidence. Draft by EOD and circulate.

helen: I'll paste grep output into the ticket and drop one example event we saw:

helen: ```
{
  "event_type": "token_issue",
  "service": "api-gateway",
  "user_id": "acct_12345",
  "client_id": "svc-frontend",
  "grant_type": "refresh_token",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-18T21:07:43Z",
  "request_id": "req-9f3b2",
  "raw": "<original-payload-truncated>"
}
```

maria: I'll draft the parser patch and a rollout plan (canary + metric to detect KeyError regressions).

sam: I'll map console/billing RBAC events to our audit schema and add validation rules for display of customer-facing audit records.

alex: Thanks all. Next check-in in #2h or ping on the ticket if anything blocks.
